instrument: Contracting Policy Notice 2007-4 (Non-Competitive Contracting)
what_it_says (short/paraphrased): Requires explaining why the price is fair and reasonable for a non-competitive contract, tied to the "only one person capable of performing the work" exception; last amended 2019-06-10 for Government Contracts Regulations changes; page not rescinded. Belonged to the "Contracting Policy", replaced 2021-05-13 by the current Directive on the Management of Procurement, which does not use this phrase (see TBS-DMP-4.3.1 instead). Background only; not relied on as a citation requirement (OPEN-QUESTIONS.md #4).

instrument: Directive on Security Management, Appendix J: Standard on Security Categorization (TBS)
what_it_says (short/paraphrased): Classified = Confidential / Secret / Top Secret (injury to the national interest). Protected A / B / C = injury outside the national interest; Protected B example includes loss of reputation or competitive advantage; Protected A example: an exact salary figure. In effect 2019-07-01.

instrument: Guide on the use of generative artificial intelligence (TBS) - guidance, not a directive
what_it_says (short/paraphrased): Public servants must not input personal information into publicly available online generative AI tools. Do not enter sensitive or personal information into tools not managed by the GC. Seek the institutional chief security officer's approval before using generative AI for protected or other sensitive information. Applies to federal institutions; applicability to NCC unconfirmed.

what_it_says (short/paraphrased): JSON fact records; generic by default, but a record whose review.figures_approved is true carries an individually reviewed unit price with a coarse price_date and price_basis for one or more pay_items. Not the source documents themselves. Optional -- only usable when the repo is cloned locally beside this kit.

instrument: Statistics Canada, Industrial product price index, by product, monthly (table 18-10-0266-01)
what_it_says (short/paraphrased): Monthly commodity-level price index (NAPCS Canada 2022), base 202001=100, from 1956-01 to 2026-08 (release 2026-09-17). Construction-relevant product groups: P41 (lumber and other wood products), P63 (fabricated metal products and construction materials), P81 (cement, glass and other non-metallic mineral products), P61/P62 (ferrous/non-ferrous metals). This is materials-cost movement, not a building or project price -- use it to inflation-adjust a prior comparable, not as a comparable itself. A companion table, the Raw Materials Price Index (18-10-0268-01), was referenced in StatCan release notes but not itself opened or verified.
